The silver cast fails on these rows; parsing both formats fixes it.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.9,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH parsed AS (SELECT *, COALESCE(try_strptime(txn_ts, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'), try_strptime(txn_ts, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S'), TRY_CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP)) AS ts_parsed FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(ts_parsed AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(ts_parsed AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM parsed"}}
